notes: Complete Ponte Giuseppe Mazzini: three open segmental stone arches, two rounded river piers with waterline bases and projecting springing caps, ashlar spandrels, pale travertine arch rings and cornice, broad road with raised verge walks, pierced circular stone parapets and green-patinated ornamental lamps with small rostral scroll forms. Preserve the complete mapped crossing and both independent riverside routes beneath the outer spans.
